title: User authentication
text: When a user attempts to log in, the LabQC Connect system shall authenticate the user against the laboratory directory before granting access.

title: Configuration permissions
text: The LabQC Connect system shall restrict configuration changes to users with the Supervisor role.

title: ASTM result intake
text: When an analyzer sends a QC result over ASTM E1394, the LabQC Connect system shall store the result within 2 seconds.

title: HL7 result transmission
text: When a QC result is accepted, the LabQC Connect system shall transmit the result to the LIS as an HL7 v2.5 ORU^R01 message.

title: Chart update time
text: When a QC result is stored, the LabQC Connect system shall display the result on the Levey-Jennings chart within 3 seconds.

title: Lot records
text: The LabQC Connect system shall record the lot number and expiry date of each QC material.

title: Westgard rule evaluation
text: When a QC result violates a configured Westgard rule, the LabQC Connect system shall flag the result and notify the assigned user.

title: Audit logging
text: The LabQC Connect system shall record every user action and every outbound message with a timestamp and user ID.

title: Expired lot block
text: If a QC material lot is expired, then the LabQC Connect system shall prevent new results from being accepted for that lot.

title: Audit export
text: When a user requests an audit export, the LabQC Connect system shall export the selected audit records as a PDF.
